params.name: revisedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been revised after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: revisedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been revised before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: first
params.description: The number of results to return. Default value is 10. Any custom value specified must lie between 0 and 100, inclusive.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor to start returning results from

params.name: sort
params.description: The field used for sorting the results. If not provided, 'createdAt' will be used as the default sort field.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order used for the given sort field. If not provided, the default sort order is 'asc'.

params.name: issuedBefore
params.description: Filter to only results that have been issued (finalized and set to status OPEN) before this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.

params.name: issuedAfter
params.description: Filter to only results that have been issued (finalized and set to status OPEN) after this timestamp. This can be a UTC timestamp or a floating date. If a floating date is passed, the timestamp used will be the beginning (midnight UTC) of the date.
